_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Kuwa kuwa a yin Golf (Kad Kadi) - Mai kadi {player_id}.
Manufa: Samu ƙananan maki a wannan zagaye. Idan ginshi yakan raba ɗaya daraja, ana ƙididdige su azaman 0.
Daraja Kadi: A=1, 2-10=daraja fuska, J/Q=10, K=0

Ayyuka (amfani da mabugu daidai):
- '[draw]' - Jawo daga ɗan kadi
- '[take]' - ɗauka daga tariyar wandon kadi
- '[swap X Y]' - Mubaya kadi jawo da matsayi X (safu) Y (ɗangali)
- '[discard]' - Wandon kadi jawo.

board.drew:
Ka jawo: {card}
Yanzu ka wajibi [swap X Y] ko [discard] shi.
board.took:
Ka ɗauka: {card} daga tariyar wandon kadi
Ka wajibi [swap X Y] da shi (ba za ka iya wandon).

options.final_turns: Zagaye na ƙarshe! Ka zaɓi: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Nyiye: [swap X Y] (kərtəwa gәnyi raksa koltǝgǝn)

message.deck_empty: Kәla dәn ba! Tambo dǝ dawunaro dawono.
message.knocked: Kambiwu {pid} dǝga kǝla fuwunna! Kam ndasoye fallo waljin.
message.final_round: Mai kadi {pid} {reason}! Kowane mai kadi yaɗa zagaye ɗaya.

invalid.wrong_action: Mɛn ɗon ɓɛ ɓɛlɛnɛnɛ ɓɛ ɓɛ: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], ɓe [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Ka wajibi kuwa [draw], [take], [knock], ko [peek X Y] farko
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Karta do suro karәgәwa bannabe dәn gozanyi ma ba. Shima faljinna.
invalid.have_drawn_card: A ɓɛɛlɛnɛnɛ kɛrɛnɛ. Mɛn ɗon ɓɛ [swap X Y] ɓe ɓɛ [discard]
invalid.out_of_bounds: ɗɛnɛ ɓɛ ɓɛlɛnɛnɛ. Mɛn ɗon ɓɛ row 1-{max_row}, column 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Karta fәlejin dәn gәnyi kәrtube sәdin. Kәla buroye lan cida nәm kamma ro yikkәmin.
invalid.already_knocked: Kam laa dǝ buron kǝla adǝyen zauro zortǝna.
